page.overview:
What is Dipplin?

Dipplin is a green worm-like Pokémon that lives in a red apple spewing a similarly colored mixture. Its head greatly resembles the head of Applin, but with a long, thin protuberance in the middle of its eyestalks. Its tail is green with a tan underside and green leaf-like growths sticking out of it.

Dipplin’s head and tail are considered two separate creatures that work together to move around.

Dipplin has the ability to produce a sweet syrup from its body. This syrup can be used to beguile opponents. This syrup is used in its signature move, Syrup Bomb, and its signature ability, Supersweet Syrup.

Dipplin evolves from Applin after consuming a Syrupy Apple and evolves into Hydrapple when leveled up while knowing the move Dragon Cheer.
